items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Ben Webster, Coleman Hawkins, Don Byas. I'm talking about saxophonists.

ctx.x: Interpret that in the way that he wanted.

He wanted. It would be just perfect because Duke could see Johnny playing an idea of his. Paul Gonzalves is another beautiful saxophonist. Ben Webster, Coleman Hawkins, Don Byas. I'm talking about saxophonists. You don't find them like that no more and it's funny because those guys -- I remember Ben made a statement that his whole idea when he was coming up was to play with a beautiful tone, you know, and it seems like kids have thrown that away. They don't strive for no sound, no pure sound. Most of them,…
